retraction.reason: Retracted in M44b, class C. The treaty of 1967 has one available neighbour in this atlas, the Charter, on the ground that the treaty was negotiated in a United Nations committee. Portugal is a party and no Portuguese event here touches it. The edge that could be written would be indistinguishable from the edge to every other United Nations instrument, and a round whose whole point is honest connection should not write it.
